description: Sequential minimization returns \(n\) exactly when the test at \(n\) is defined with value zero and every earlier test has a defined positive value.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PartialRecursiveFunctions.minimize_spec {k : ℕ}
  (f : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PartialRecursiveFunctions.PFunction (k + 1))
  (x : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PartialRecursiveFunctions.Args k) (n : ℕ) :
  n ∈ Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PartialRecursiveFunctions.minimize f x ↔
    0 ∈ f (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PartialRecursiveFunctions.snoc x n) ∧
      ∀ i < n, ∃ a, 0 < a ∧ a ∈ f (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PartialRecursiveFunctions.snoc x i)
